hand_landmarker.task.about: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker model as bundled in Google's mediapipe-samples repository (Apache-2.0), copied unmodified. Contains hand_detector.tflite and hand_landmarks_detector.tflite dated 2023-04-26.
hand_landmarker.task.note: Not byte-compared with the official file: this project's build sandbox could not download from storage.googleapis.com. Run `npm run fetch-models` to replace it with the official file and record that file's hash here.
